acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks with people who've been hit by lightning. They describe what happened at the moment the bolt struck... and how they came to view it later.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: David Rakoff goes in search of the only existing mementos of a year-and-a-half of his life when he nearly died from Hodgkins Disease. The missing relics are his own pre-chemotherapized sperm — which reside somewhere in a Toronto lab. But over the years, his hospital has moved, the lab has moved, and he has moved.
acts.title: I Used To Bank Here But That Was Long, Long Ago

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Keith Gessen, a young Russian emigre, revisits the heroes of his youth: the brave Soviet dissidents who risked their lives at the height of the Cold War. Many of them resettled into comfortable suburban lives in America. That these idealists would wind up on shady streets where private lives are more important than public ones is perplexing to Keith.
acts.title: Exile On Main Street

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Producer Julie Snyder looks at what happens in one poor Chicago neighborhood when the community begins to undergo a revitalization and a new store comes to town.
acts.title: Shopping for a Better Future
